Encouraging equitable distribution of tasks can lead to healthier family dynamics. It's better when everyone contributes based on their capabilities rather than traditional roles. So, if the expectation is that only women should do this, it's limiting and unfair. In summary, while helping family members is generally a positive thing, the issue arises when the expectation is based solely on gender.
